FreyaTTS-small is vendored from https://github.com/freyavoiceai/FreyaTTS
at commit 146d36c1cb6660646be57d31339db4eed9315de3.
Its source and model are licensed under Apache-2.0; see FREYATTS-LICENSE.
The Freya model weights and VoxCPM2 AudioVAE weights are downloaded from
Hugging Face when the local speech engine is first used. The required AudioVAE
model code is vendored from VoxCPM 2.0.3 under Apache-2.0; see VOXCPM-LICENSE.
